issue.body:
Fixes #159744 
Summary:
```
import torch

# Generate input data
input_tensor = torch.randn(3, 3)
stream = torch.cuda.Stream()

# Call the API
input_tensor.record_stream(stream)
```

⚠️ will now show an error message
`torch.cuda.Stream requires CUDA support`

cc: @malfet
